integrity: Exact transfer identities, symbolic inequalities, and independent finite determinant checks are provided; finite diagnostics are not treated as infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform unweighted spanning trees on simple cubic prism graphs only; no claim about weighted graphs, other vertex pairs, or other cubic graphs. Historical priority remains to be independently checked, particularly for consequences of available explicit circular-ladder resistance formulas.
title: Orientation-dependent sign reversal of adjacent leaf correlations in uniform prism spanning trees
